Someone mentioned to me that in New Spring, there is a scene in which the Amyrlin dismisses all the male clerks from the Tower, including those who don't like women.  Is this the only mention of gay men in the series?  [[User:Ogier|Ogier]] 20:44, 18 September 2006 (UTC)
:That event doesn't sound familiar, and a quick scan through the book doesn't reveal it. Do you have a specific paragraph/section? --[[User:TheParanoidOne|TheParanoidOne]] 22:36, 18 September 2006 (UTC)
::I think this is the one line:
::{{quote|An Amyrlin was supposed to grant indulgences and relief from penances on the day she assumed the stole and the staff. None came from Sierin, and in the space of half a week, every last male clerk in the Tower had been dismissed without a character, supposedly for flirting with novices or Accepted, or for “inappropriate looks and glances”, which could have meant anything. Even men so old their grandchildren had children went, and some who had no liking for women at all.|{{ns|14}}, Changes}}
